references.description: Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does thereby cause hurt to any person, is said voluntarily to cause hurt.
required_elements: hurt

source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 115

references.punishment: 115(2): up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 10,000, or both.

references.offence_name: Rash driving or riding on a public way
references.description: Whoever drives any vehicle, or rides, on any public way in a manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life, or to be likely to cause hurt or injury to any other person, shall be punished.
required_elements: driving or riding vehicle on a public way
manner so rash or negligent as to endanger human life or likely to cause hurt

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 281

references.punishment: Up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both.

references.description: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide, shall be punished with imprisonment.
required_elements: death of a human being
rash or negligent act causing the death
act does not amount to culpable homicide

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 106

references.punishment: 106(1): up to 5 years and fine (up to 2 years for registered medical practitioners); 106(2): up to 10 years and fine for fleeing without reporting.

references.offence_name: Act endangering life or personal safety of others
references.description: Whoever does any act so rashly or negligently as to endanger human life or the personal safety of others, shall be punished.
required_elements: rash or negligent act
endangering human life or personal safety of others

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 125

references.punishment: Up to 3 months or fine up to Rs 2,500 (or both); if hurt is caused: up to 6 months or fine up to Rs 5,000; if grievous hurt: up to 3 years or fine up to Rs 10,000.

references.description: Whoever with intent to cause, or knowing that he is likely to cause, wrongful loss or damage to the public or to any person, causes the destruction of any property, or any such change in any property or in the situation thereof as destroys or diminishes its value or utility, or affects it injuriously, commits mischief.
required_elements: intent or knowledge to cause wrongful loss or damage
destruction or diminishment in value/utility of property

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023), section 324

references.offence_name: Report of police officer on completion of investigation
references.description: Every investigation under this Chapter shall be completed without unnecessary delay. As soon as it is completed, the officer in charge of the police station shall forward to a Magistrate empowered to take cognizance of the offence on a police report, a report in the form prescribed.
required_elements: completion of police investigation
submission of final report to competent Magistrate

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act 46 of 2023), section 193

references.offence_name: Admissibility of electronic records in evidence
references.description: Any information contained in an electronic record which is printed on a paper, stored, recorded or copied in optical or magnetic media shall be deemed to be also a document, and shall be admissible in any proceedings.
required_elements: electronic record captured or stored
certification or chain of custody of device output

source.publisher: Ministry of Law and Justice, India Code
source.citation: The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (Act 47 of 2023), section 63

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): sexual intercourse or penetration with a woman; against her will or without her consent.
required_elements: sexual intercourse or penetration with a woman
against her will or without her consent
references.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not less than 10 years, extendable to life, and fine.

references.offence_name: Assault or criminal force to a woman with intent to outrage her modesty
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): assault or use of criminal force on a woman; intent or knowledge that it is likely to outrage her modesty.
required_elements: assault or use of criminal force on a woman
intent or knowledge that it is likely to outrage her modesty
references.punishment: Imprisonment of 1 to 5 years and fine.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): unwelcome physical contact or advances, sexual remarks, or showing pornography against the will of a woman.
required_elements: unwelcome physical contact or advances, sexual remarks, or showing pornography against the will of a woman
references.punishment: Up to 3 years, or fine, or both (depending on the limb).

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): following or repeatedly contacting a woman despite clear disinterest, or monitoring her internet or electronic communication.
required_elements: following or repeatedly contacting a woman despite clear disinterest, or monitoring her internet or electronic communication
references.punishment: First conviction: up to 3 years and fine; subsequent: up to 5 years and fine.

references.offence_name: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman.
required_elements: word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
references.punishment: Up to 3 years and fine.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): death of a woman by burns, bodily injury or otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of marriage; cruelty or harassment by husband or relatives for dowry soon before her death.
required_elements: death of a woman by burns, bodily injury or otherwise than under normal circumstances within seven years of marriage
cruelty or harassment by husband or relatives for dowry soon before her death
references.punishment: Imprisonment not less than 7 years, extendable to life.

references.offence_name: Cruelty by husband or his relatives
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): woman subjected to cruelty by her husband or his relative; cruelty includes wilful conduct likely to drive her to suicide or cause grave injury, or harassment for an unlawful demand.
required_elements: woman subjected to cruelty by her husband or his relative
cruelty includes wilful conduct likely to drive her to suicide or cause grave injury, or harassment for an unlawful demand
references.punishment: Up to 3 years and fine.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): death of a human being; act done with the intention of causing death or bodily injury likely to cause death.
required_elements: death of a human being
act done with the intention of causing death or bodily injury likely to cause death
references.punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, and fine.

references.offence_name: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): death of a human being; act done with the intention or knowledge that it is likely to cause death, not amounting to murder.
required_elements: death of a human being
act done with the intention or knowledge that it is likely to cause death, not amounting to murder
references.punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine (first part); up to 10 years or fine or both (second part).

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): attempt to cause death with the intention or knowledge of murder; act done towards committing murder, such as use of a weapon, firearm or poison.
required_elements: attempt to cause death with the intention or knowledge of murder
act done towards committing murder, such as use of a weapon, firearm or poison
references.punishment: Up to 10 years and fine; imprisonment for life if hurt is caused.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): grievous hurt caused, such as fracture, dislocation, permanent disfigurement, loss of a limb, sight or hearing, or a life-endangering injury; act done voluntarily.
required_elements: grievous hurt caused, such as fracture, dislocation, permanent disfigurement, loss of a limb, sight or hearing, or a life-endangering injury
act done voluntarily
references.punishment: 117(2): up to 7 years and fine; higher penalties where permanent disability or vegetative state results.
references.compoundable: Compoundable with permission of the court

references.offence_name: Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): hurt or grievous hurt caused; caused by a weapon or instrument likely to cause death, or by fire, poison, acid or other corrosive substance.
required_elements: hurt or grievous hurt caused
caused by a weapon or instrument likely to cause death, or by fire, poison, acid or other corrosive substance
references.punishment: 118(1): up to 3 years, or fine, or both (hurt); 118(2): up to 10 years or life and fine (grievous hurt). Bailability differs by limb.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): person voluntarily obstructed from proceeding in a direction in which he has a right to proceed.
required_elements: person voluntarily obstructed from proceeding in a direction in which he has a right to proceed
references.punishment: 126(2): up to 1 month, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): person wrongfully restrained so as to prevent him from proceeding beyond certain limits.
required_elements: person wrongfully restrained so as to prevent him from proceeding beyond certain limits
references.punishment: 127(2): up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both.

references.offence_name: Assault or criminal force otherwise than on grave provocation
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): assault or use of criminal force on any person; not done on grave and sudden provocation.
required_elements: assault or use of criminal force on any person
not done on grave and sudden provocation
references.punishment: Up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs 1,000, or both.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): taking or enticing a minor or person of unsound mind out of the keeping of the lawful guardian; without the consent of the lawful guardian.
required_elements: taking or enticing a minor or person of unsound mind out of the keeping of the lawful guardian
without the consent of the lawful guardian
references.punishment: 137(2): up to 7 years and fine.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): dishonest intention to take property; movable property taken out of the possession of a person; taken without that person's consent.
required_elements: dishonest intention to take property
movable property taken out of the possession of a person
taken without that person's consent
references.punishment: 303(2): up to 3 years, or fine, or both; subsequent conviction: rigorous imprisonment 1 to 5 years and fine.
references.compoundable: Compoundable by the owner (with court permission in some cases)

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): theft committed by suddenly or forcibly seizing or snatching property from a person or his possession.
required_elements: theft committed by suddenly or forcibly seizing or snatching property from a person or his possession
references.punishment: Up to 3 years and fine.

references.offence_name: Theft in a dwelling house, means of transportation or place of worship
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): theft of property; committed in a dwelling house, a place of worship or a means of transport.
required_elements: theft of property
committed in a dwelling house, a place of worship or a means of transport
references.punishment: Up to 7 years and fine.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): putting a person in fear of injury; dishonestly inducing delivery of property or valuable security.
required_elements: putting a person in fear of injury
dishonestly inducing delivery of property or valuable security
references.punishment: 308(2): up to 3 years, or fine, or both; higher where the threat is of death, grievous hurt or accusation of an offence.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): theft or extortion; offender causes or attempts to cause death, hurt or wrongful restraint, or fear of them, to commit the theft or carry away the property.
required_elements: theft or extortion
offender causes or attempts to cause death, hurt or wrongful restraint, or fear of them, to commit the theft or carry away the property
references.punishment: 309(4): rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; up to 14 years if on a highway between sunset and sunrise.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): entrustment of property or dominion over property; dishonest misappropriation, conversion to own use, or disposal in violation of law or contract.
required_elements: entrustment of property or dominion over property
dishonest misappropriation, conversion to own use, or disposal in violation of law or contract
references.punishment: 316(2): up to 5 years, or fine, or both; higher penalties for carriers, clerks, public servants and bankers.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): the property is stolen property; dishonestly receiving or retaining it knowing or having reason to believe it is stolen.
required_elements: the property is stolen property
dishonestly receiving or retaining it knowing or having reason to believe it is stolen
references.punishment: 317(2): up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): deception of a person; fraudulently or dishonestly inducing delivery of property or an act or omission causing damage.
required_elements: deception of a person
fraudulently or dishonestly inducing delivery of property or an act or omission causing damage
references.punishment: 318(2): up to 3 years, or fine, or both; 318(4) (inducing delivery of property): up to 7 years and fine.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): threat of injury to a person, reputation or property; intent to cause alarm or to compel an act the person is not legally bound to do.
required_elements: threat of injury to a person, reputation or property
intent to cause alarm or to compel an act the person is not legally bound to do
references.punishment: 351(2): up to 2 years, or fine, or both; up to 7 years for threats of death or grievous hurt.

references.offence_name: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of the peace
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023): intentional insult; giving provocation intending or knowing it will cause a breach of the peace or another offence.
required_elements: intentional insult
giving provocation intending or knowing it will cause a breach of the peace or another offence
references.punishment: Up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Motor Vehicles Act, 1988): driving a motor vehicle in a public place; in a manner dangerous to the public having regard to the circumstances, including the nature, condition and use of the place and traffic.
required_elements: driving a motor vehicle in a public place
in a manner dangerous to the public having regard to the circumstances, including the nature, condition and use of the place and traffic
references.punishment: Imprisonment and/or fine; higher for repeat offences (see statute for current scales).

references.offence_name: Driving by a drunken person or under the influence of drugs
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Motor Vehicles Act, 1988): driving or attempting to drive a motor vehicle; under the influence of alcohol beyond the permitted blood-alcohol limit, or of drugs.
required_elements: driving or attempting to drive a motor vehicle
under the influence of alcohol beyond the permitted blood-alcohol limit, or of drugs
references.punishment: Imprisonment and/or fine; higher for repeat offences (see statute for current scales).

references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Information Technology Act, 2000): fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's electronic signature, password or other unique identification feature.
required_elements: fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's electronic signature, password or other unique identification feature
references.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to Rs 1 lakh.

references.offence_name: Cheating by personation using a computer resource
references.description: Summary of ingredients (not statutory text; verify against The Information Technology Act, 2000): cheating by personation; using a computer resource or communication device.
required_elements: cheating by personation
using a computer resource or communication device
references.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to Rs 1 lakh.
